seoTitle: How to Change Country or Region on eBay Shipping
metaDescription: Update your country, ship-from location, and return address on eBay to keep shipping rates and listings accurate after relocating.
intro: If you've moved to a different country or are managing multiple selling locations, your eBay shipping and return details need to reflect that to avoid pricing errors and buyer confusion. This guide covers updating your account settings, ship-from address, and return address on both the website and app.

steps.heading: Open your eBay account settings
steps.body: Go to your account settings on the eBay website or app where address and region information is managed.

steps.heading: Update your ship-from location
steps.body: Edit the ship-from address so your listings reflect where items are actually being shipped from.

steps.heading: Update your return address
steps.body: Make sure your return address is current so buyers send items back to the correct location.

steps.heading: Verify your listings show accurate location info
steps.body: Double-check that your active listings display the updated country and shipping details correctly.

faq.question: Why does my ship-from address matter on eBay?
faq.answer: It affects shipping rates and delivery estimates shown to buyers, so keeping it accurate helps avoid pricing errors.

faq.question: Can I change my country on both the app and website?
faq.answer: Yes, this guide covers accessing account settings from both the eBay website and the mobile app.

faq.question: What happens if my return address is outdated?
faq.answer: Buyers may send returns to the wrong location, which can lead to conflicts or delayed refunds.

faq.question: Who needs to update these settings most?
faq.answer: Sellers relocating to another country or managing multiple locations benefit most from keeping this information current.
